input:
Earlier scenes:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

This scene:
别的人给了神农一个灵芝。这个植物可以让神农更好。比方说，他会觉得更健康。吃灵芝以后，他可以再走。现在他觉得更好。最后，神农找到了很多植物，他可以用对药。这些植物让神农很高兴。神农想跟很多人分享他的新药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 这个植物可以让神农更好：身体更好
- 比方说，他会觉得更健康：比方说is used to express “for example”, delete it
- 吃灵芝以后，他可以再走：吃了，了completed; 又可以走了

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人给了神农：一个人给了神农，别的人 means “other people” in contrast with a previously mentioned person or group; here a new, unspecified person is being introduced. [teacher rule: bieren]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 用对药：用来做药，use 用来 to introduce the purpose of the plants; 对 does not mean “to make medicine,” while 做药 means making medicine from them. [rule: word_choice]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这个植物：它，The lingzhi was named in the sentence immediately before, so use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence. [rule: none]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 最后，神农找到了很多植物：最后，他找到了很多植物，Shen Nong was the clear referent in the preceding sentence, so a pronoun avoids an unnecessary repeated name. [rule: none]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这些植物让神农很高兴：这些植物让他很高兴，Use a pronoun when the recently mentioned character is still clear. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农想跟很多人分享他的新药：他想跟很多人分享他的新药，The same character continues from the previous sentence, so a pronoun is more natural. [rule: none]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 吃灵芝以后：吃了灵芝以后，The eating is completed before Shen Nong can walk again, so it needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “别的人” is wrong for introducing one additional unspecified person, but the shown correction is cut off after 给了神农 and lacks the thing given.
“用对药” is not a correct way to say that the plants are used to make medicine; “用来做药” is correct.
灵芝 was just introduced, so the close re-reference should be “它” under the teacher’s reference rule.
神农 is the clear recent referent, so repeating his name should be replaced by “他”.
神农 remains the clear recent character, so “他” is required instead of repeating his name.
The same recently mentioned character continues, so “他” should replace the repeated name.
The eating must be completed before the later walking, so “吃了灵芝以后” correctly adds perfective 了.
